text:
deploy-bot: finished rollout canary->eu-west-1 (r12.4.0). starting post-deploy smoke checks. dashboard: https://console.redwood.dev/releases/r12.4.0

alice: synth runner flagged 5xx/429 spikes on /v1/embeddings, mostly from gpu-eu-4. p95 up to 900ms.

ben: i see 4/100 failures in last 6m, host gpu-eu-4 returning 503 json {"error":"backend_unavailable"}.

carol: oncall-bot healthprobe shows gpu-eu-4 failing L7 since 09:12:02, autorestart attempted.

oncall-bot: probe-summary: gpu-eu-1..gpu-eu-5 -> gpu-eu-4 unhealthy. recent warmup/prefill started 09:10:45.

dinesh: warmup logs: prefill completed but logged "kv_segment_mismatch" for several keys. suggests partial KV state.

eva: rollout policy allows region-level routing pin. recommend pin embed-route in eu-west-1 back to r12.3.9 until host repaired. less disruptive than full rollback.

alice: agree. action list: pin embed-route, cordon/drain gpu-eu-4, run kv-repair, rerun smoke.

deploy-bot: pin request created RB-4501. apply now? :white_check_mark: / :x:

ben: +1 apply.

carol: pin applied at 09:16:18 UTC (rc-4821-pin). routing traffic off gpu-eu-4.

oncall-bot: cordon started, draining connections.

dinesh: running kv-inspect + repair on gpu-eu-4, will attach dump when done.

eva: reran synth after pin: 0/100 failures in 3m, p95 back to baseline.

carol: kv-repair reported repaired_segments=3, final healthchecks green for 2m.

alice: propose hold pin 10m while full smoke suite runs, then unpin if stable.

ben: +1. file follow-up INF-1135 for prefill race on model weight sync.

deploy-bot: scheduled unpin check at 09:26:18 UTC; will post summary then.
